title: MIDDAY STRENGTH
PSALM 138:3
end: The Midday Watch — pause and pray at noon
stock_queries: bright midday sun shining through a quiet window
sunlight on an empty wooden desk at noon
high noon light over green fields and hills
warm midday light on stone walls
bright noon sun filtering through trees
peaceful noon light over calm water
midday sun casting long shadows indoors

scenes.a: That sudden phone notification you are dreading right now does not have the final word over your peace.
Lord, when the demands of this afternoon pile higher than my energy can reach, meet me right here.
In the day when I cried thou answeredst me, and strengthenedst me with strength in my soul.
Father, renew the weary places inside my mind and steady my hands for the hours still ahead.
Pour your quiet confidence into this room, pushing back every anxious thought that tries to settle here.
Let your steadfast grace carry me through the rest of this day with quiet trust and steady hope.
